cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Choose What Matters More
cards.instruction: Make someone choose between emotional safety and the outcome they claim to want.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll settle the lease over dinner. Do you want my honest answer about living together?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes. Just don't say anything that makes me panic.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We can order first. But shall I answer after, even if it upsets you?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Answer. But start by saying we're fine.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then choose: a quiet dinner, or my answer. I'll put the lease away if it's dinner.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 directs the lease conversation; A3 changes timing for B comfort; A5 makes ending it a concrete option while insisting on a choice about emotional risk.

responseLogic.evidence: B4 wants an honest answer constrained to reassurance; A5 can offer quiet dinner by putting away the lease, without claiming both conditions are compatible.

relationship.evidence: B2 fears panic and B4 asks for a specific reassuring beginning, a plausible attempt to secure emotional safety.

heightening.evidence: B4 would dictate the answer; A5 makes B choose whether the discussion proceeds without that guarantee.

specificity.evidence: A5 quiet dinner now explicitly names emotional safety against the honest answer B2 says is wanted; lease stakes remain in A1.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 contains the choice and the action A will take to honor it; the redundant stopping preface is gone.
